content: असित {%a.%} .²1 Unbound (<ab>Ved.</ab>). .²2 [न सितः शुभ्रः] Not white, black, dark-blue, dark-coloured; असिता मोहरजनी <ls>Śānti. 3. 4</ls>; <ls>Y. 3. 166</ls>; ˚लोचना, ˚नयना <ab>&c.</ab> .{@-तः@} .²1 The dark or blue colour. .²2 the dark fortnight of lunar month. .²3 <ab>N.</ab> of the planet Saturn. .²4 A black snake. .²5 <ab>N.</ab> of the sage देवल; असितो देवलो व्यासः <ls>Bg. 10. 13</ls>. .²6 <ab>N.</ab> of a being presiding over darkness and magic. .²7 <ab>N.</ab> of Kṛṣṇa; विसृजन्दिक्षु सर्वासु शरानसितसारथिः <ls>Mb. 7. 146. 44</ls>. .{@-ता@} .²1 The Indigo plant. .²2 A girl attending upon the harem (whose hair is not whitened by age); see असिक्नी. .²3 The river Yamunā. .²4 <ab>N.</ab> of a daughter of Vīraṇa and wife of Dakṣa. .²5 <ab>N.</ab> of the river. Akesines (चन्द्रभागा) in the Punjab; <ls>Rv. 8. 20. 25</ls>.
